title: TWARABiO™ Herbal Skin Care Lotion
summary: A herbal skin care lotion developed for specialised skin care, helping maintain skin hydration and comfort while supporting care of pressure-prone skin.
description: Topical Herbal Steroid-free Skin Care Lotion for Bed/Pressure-prone Skin Care.
composition: Aloe vera base enriched with traditional herbal extracts of Neem, Turmeric, Manjishtha and other selected herbs.
usage: Suitable for frequent application and for all skin types (dry, sensitive or fragile skin). Patch test required on burning or inflamed skin.
